svg.title: P5 cut planes
svg.text: Cut planes through the die and the middle fin (s = 0.5 mm)
Left: plane y = 20 mm (across the fins). Right: plane through the middle of fin 4. Vertical scale = horizontal scale.
The die (bottom, under the base centre) is the hottest part; the base spreads the heat sideways
before it enters the fins, so the middle fins run hotter than the outer ones.
